structured.feedback: The response covers all six fields accurately and leaves out PII. It lists meloxicam 15 mg daily and ibuprofen 800 mg twice daily as needed correctly, and the follow-up has bracing, PT three times a week and no skiing or gymnastics. Minor flaws: "at rest" for the 7/10 pain is unsupported, and the chief complaint attaches instability to the right knee when it was the left. At about 200 words it runs over the ~150 target, which matches earlier accepted cases.
